item.title: People don't care
item.description: What I think is largely missing from the online discourse on AI slop, is that most people don’t really care. You, reader, may think: “But I am not most people, I care a lot!” That may be true — you may care about your own work and others, and despise that slop is spreading into everything (code, creative writing, design). But most people don’t. Slop is already abundant; once it reads as the new normal, most people will simply accept it and not question it too much.

item.title: AI Math Day in CUHK-Shenzhen
item.description: I visited the AI Math Day workshop in CUHK-Shenzhen, organized by Dmitry Rybin and colleagues, Cosme Louart and Miha Brešar. It was my first time on the CUHK-Shenzhen campus as well, so I arrived early and took the chance to wander around despite the extreme mid-day heat. It is always interesting to note the little contrasts between the new surroundings and the city’s landscape and atmosphere to which I am already accustomed.
